minutes.description: How many minutes the sandbox is up.

size.description:
Sandbox size to price, as `<vCPU>x<memory in GiB>`.

* `1x2` - 1 vCPU, 2 GiB
* `2x4` - 2 vCPU, 4 GiB
* `2x8` - 2 vCPU, 8 GiB
* `4x8` - 4 vCPU, 8 GiB
* `4x16` - 4 vCPU, 16 GiB
* `8x16` - 8 vCPU, 16 GiB
* `8x32` - 8 vCPU, 32 GiB
* `16x64` - 16 vCPU, 64 GiB
